calculators/plan.alt: The green card timeline for a sample PERM filed January 15, 2026, EB-2 rest of world: the PERM certified around November 2, 2026, the I-140 approved around March 2027, the I-485 filed around July 2027 and the green card around January 2028, 15 months from today, with $3,645 in government fees.

calculators/pwd.alt: The prevailing wage queue calculator for a request DOL received in September 2026: 34,515 requests ahead of it of 49,034 pending, and the backlog month by month.

calculators/deadlines.alt: The deadline calculator for a determination on August 3, 2026 and recruitment from August 23 to September 20: the wage determination's validity, the recruitment, the quiet period and the filing window, drawn to scale.

calculators/decision.alt: The PERM processing time calculator for a case DOL received on January 15, 2026: most likely decided around Monday, November 2, 2026, in a window from October 29 to November 11, with DOL deciding 644 cases a working day and its queue at January 2026.

calculators/i140.alt: The I-140 queue calculator for advanced-degree petitions: 8,644 waiting and 12,477 decided last quarter, USCIS's published time of 3 months and its quarterly median of 3.9 months for every I-140, and the queue 2,999 petitions longer than the quarter before.

calculators/line.alt: The green card line for an EB-2 India priority date of June 15, 2019: 146,000 to 366,000 people ahead, 37 to 94 years at the pace of fiscal year 2024.

calculators/h1b.alt: The H-1B six-year limit for status that began October 1, 2021: six years end September 30, 2027, 344 days left, and a PERM filed March 2, 2026 meets the 365-day rule.

data/cases.alt: The PERM cases page: 373,939 decided cases in DOL's published files, October 2023 to June 2026, and 160,716 newer from DOL's live service, with the cases DOL decides each month since 2015.

data/wait.alt: The PERM processing times page: about 336 days from filing to a decision by DOL's figure of October 21, 2026, DOL deciding cases filed in January 2026, the audit review queue at December 2025 and wage requests at June 2026.

data/pwd.alt: The wage request page: PERM wage requests taking 3 to 4 months by DOL's figure of September 30, 2026, 47,494 waiting and 886,809 decided, DOL deciding requests filed in June 2026, and a search by employer.

data/recruitment.alt: The PERM recruitment page, from 276,788 decided cases through June 30, 2026: a median 120 days from the first step to filing, 97% Sunday newspapers, 65% a job search website, 98% the notice posted at the workplace, and how long before filing each step ran.

data/employers.alt: Google LLC's employer page: 1,617 PERM filings, 1,608 certified, a 99.8% approval rate, a median wage of $119,350, a median 347 days, and 15 cases waiting at DOL now.

data/places.alt: The PERM filings by state page: a map of the United States shaded by filings at each worksite state, from 51 to 67,742, with 361,922 filings across 55 states and territories in the current disclosure window, 332,545 of them certified.

data/wages.alt: The PERM salary explorer: 343,211 cases with a usable wage, a median of $103,272, the 5th percentile at $24,960 and the 95th at $199,597, and where the wages land in $10,000 bands.

data/line.alt: The visa bulletin page: what the November 2026 bulletin did to every employment category and country, EB-2 rest of world moving 90 days to April 1, 2025, then what every earlier December bulletin did.

data/i140.alt: The USCIS processing times page for April to June 2026: 3.9 months to decide an I-140, 6 for an employment-based I-485, 6.4 for a work permit and 5.8 for advance parole, with 12,807,907 applications pending at USCIS.

data/visas.alt: The H-1B LCAs page: 5,975 waiting at DOL now, 3,754,961 decided with the wage offered and published through June 30, 2026, and LCAs by the month they were filed.
